theorems.name: Submission.aetp_c1_piece_approxTangent
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (G : Rn n → Amb n ℓ) (c : Rn n) (r σ : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 G → 0 < σ → (∀ b ∈ ball c r, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ G b)) → (∀ b₁ ∈ ball c r, ∀ b₂ ∈ ball c r, σ * ‖b₁ - b₂‖ ≤ ‖G b₁ - G b₂‖) → MeasurableSet (G '' ball c r) ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (G '' ball c r) < ⊤ ∧ ∀ b ∈ ball c r, Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (G '' ball c r) (G b) (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ G b).toLinearMap)
